front: Main finding of Zeng et al. (AAAI 2023)?
back: Simple one-layer linear models (DLinear, NLinear) beat many Transformer forecasters on popular long-term benchmarks.
Split the window into a moving-average trend and a remainder. One linear layer for each, then add the outputs.
Subtract the last value of the window, apply one linear layer, add the last value back.

front: Why can a linear model forecast seasonal data?
back: A weighted sum of past values can copy the same time last day or week and extend the trend.

front: What is the lasting lesson of the paper?
back: Always compare complex models with strong, simple baselines on your own data with a fair time-based split.
